# FG-REPO-0021

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`repository-purge`](../../ops/runbooks/repository-purge.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `now_fails_when_a_project_could_not_be_purged` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 完全削除できなかったプロジェクトがあります。
- en: Some projects could not be purged.
- id: Beberapa proyek tidak dapat dihapus permanen.

## 原因 (cause)

`forge admin project purge --now` (step D5 MR4) ran one batch and at least one project failed. Each failed project was already logged on its own as FG-REPO-0020 RepositoryPurgeStuck (the alert); this summary only makes the command's exit code non-zero and is deliberately not an alert, so one failure never raises two.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The context carries `failed` and `purged`; the command's output has one line per project with `failed` and the project's `request_id`. Look up those request ids for the FG-REPO-0020 lines (`step`, `cause_code`).

## 対処 (fix)

Follow the runbook repository-purge for each failed project, then run `forge admin project purge --now` again (it resumes where it stopped).
